title: Bayes' theorem
summary: Posterior is proportional to likelihood times prior.
card_back: The posterior probability is proportional to the likelihood of the data times the prior probability of the hypothesis.

title: Bayesian classifier
summary: Assigns a class by computing the posterior over classes given features.
card_front: How does the Bayesian classifier assign a class?
card_back: It computes the posterior over classes given the features and picks the class with the highest posterior. Entry point: src/model/classifier.py:12.

title: Inference pipeline
summary: Loads features, runs the classifier, writes predictions.
card_front: What are the three stages of the inference pipeline?
card_back: Load features, run the Bayesian classifier, write predictions. Entry point: src/pipeline.py:40.
